name: Greaves Cotton Ltd
title: Greaves Cotton Ltd - 501455 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Core standalone revenue up 22% and FY26 EBITDA margin up 40bp, but Q4 gross margin fell on commodity costs, capex is undefined for the year, and the EV subsidiary remains loss-making with no break-even path disclosed.

capex.quote: We will stick to our INR 500 crores to INR 700 crore overall aim for the next 5 years.

triggers.label: Q4 gross margin down on commodity costs
triggers.quote: there has been commodity cycle coming in since March and that is impacting the profitability

triggers.label: Core growth 16-18%, EBITDA 13-15% reaffirmed
triggers.quote: we will maintain 13 % to 15% EBITDA margins as we scale the business

triggers.label: Capex INR 500-700 cr over 5 years, FY26 spend ~INR 30-36 cr
triggers.quote: we are going to invest INR 500 crores to INR 700 crores

triggers.label: Commodity pass-through activated in Q1
triggers.quote: there is a passthrough mechanism, which we have already activated in Q1

guidance.quote: we would go 16% to 18% organic growth year-on-year in our core businesses
we will maintain 13 % to 15% EBITDA margins as we scale the business
We will stick to our INR 500 crores to INR 700 crore overall aim for the next 5 years.
The last 20% of the ownership of Excel is planned to be done during Q2

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have done only INR 30 crore-INR 36 crore precisely in the purchase of property, plant and equipment

red_flags.label: EV subsidiary losses; break-even not guided
red_flags.quote: unfortunately given the constraints of the DRHP, I will not be in a position to make any forward forecast for you

red_flags.label: Impairment of ePowertrain asset
red_flags.quote: we have on a conservative basis made a provision of almost INR 16 crores during the quarter

red_flags.label: Capex well below stated plan
red_flags.quote: we have done only INR 30 crore-INR 36 crore precisely in the purchase of property, plant and equipment

evasions.quote: unfortunately given the constraints of the DRHP, I will not be in a position to make any forward forecast for you
we did a full strategy reset just a few months ago, like two quarters ago
I am sorry, I will not have the details individually.
